Apertura AD8 8" Dobsonian

Maximum aperture per dollar. Point and sweep.

around $700

Eight inches of aperture on a simple push-to Dobsonian base — the most light per dollar in amateur astronomy. No batteries, no menus: point it at the sky and sweep. For scanning a patch of sky where something was reported, nothing beats a big Dob.

Where to buy

High Point Scientific

Apertura is High Point's house brand — their affiliate program is the natural fit.

Why we like it

  • Huge 8-inch aperture for the money
  • Dead simple — no power needed
  • Great for wide sky sweeps

Keep in mind

  • Bulky tube — needs car transport
  • No tracking (objects drift out of view)
  • Collimation needed now and then

Specs

Aperture8 in (203 mm)
Focal length1200 mm (f/5.9)
Focuser2-inch dual-speed Crayford
MountDobsonian (push-to)
Optical designNewtonian reflector
